transforms.code:
if value is None: return []
	if not value.has_key('_manualEntry'): return []
	
	try:
		increments = system.util.jsonDecode(value['_manualEntry']['assetAttrValue'])['increments']
	except:
		return []
	
	return increments
return True if value['attributes'].has_key('_manualEntry') and value['attributes']['_manualEntry'] else False

if value is None: return None
	return system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderId': value}))

if value is None or value['assetId'] is None: return {}
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.item.getAssetItems({'assetId': value['assetId']}), 'itemId', None)

if self.params.value.has_key('options') and self.params.value['options']['useFilterDate']: return value
	
	self.refreshBinding("custom.countInfo")
	
	return value

if len(value or []) == 0: return [[]]
	
	display = self.view.params.value.display
	
	span = 1
	if display['showAsset']: span += 1 
	if display['showOrder']: span += 1
	if display['showTime']: span += 1
	
	cols = []
	cols.append({"title": "Total", "span": span, "justify": "right", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", "backgroundColor": "--kcSurfaceVariant", "fontWeight": "bold"}})
	count = str(int(system.math.sum([item['value'] for item in value if item['value'] is not None])))
	cols.append({"title": count, "span": 1, "justify": "right", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", "backgroundColor": "--kcSurfaceVariant", "fontWeight": "bold"}})
	
	return [cols]

if len(value) == 0: return ''
	totalLaborSecs = system.math.sum([item['earnedLaborSecs'] for item in value if item['earnedLaborSecs'] is not None])
	return system.kanoa.utilities.secondsToText(totalLaborSecs, {'showDays': False, 'showSecs': False, 'showDays': False}) if totalLaborSecs > 0 else ''
return [{'value': item['workOrderId'], 'label': "%s - %s"%(item['workOrderName'], item['itemName'])} for item in value]
return True if len(value['increments']) > 0 else False

customMethods.name: addCount
customMethods.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId({'userName': 'SYSTEM'})
	counterId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('counterId', system.kanoa.asset.getCounter({'assetId': self.view.custom.filter.assetId, 'counterName': 'outfeed'}))

	addCounterInfo = {
					'counterId': counterId,
					'tStamp': system.date.now(),
					'deltaValue': value,
					'itemStateId': None,
					'itemId': self.view.custom.orders.selectedItemId,
					'workOrderId': self.view.custom.orders.selectedOrderId
				}
				
	counterEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent(addCounterInfo, userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Counts have been updated'})
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshProductionData", {'inputPayload': self.view.custom.filter})	
#	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.countInfo")
	
	return

customMethods.name: openCountEditor
customMethods.script:
userCRUD = self.view.custom.security.userCRUD
	filter = self.view.custom.filter	
	params = {'assetId': filter['assetId'], 'startDate': filter['dateRange']['startDate'], 'endDate': filter['dateRange']['endDate']}
	
	system.perspective.print('openCountEditor() called with %s'%params)	
	
	if userCRUD['isGatewayAdmin'] or userCRUD['editOperations']['enabled']:
		system.perspective.openPopup('countViewer', 'kanoa/mes/asset/counts/countEditor', {'value': params}, title='Count Editor', resizable=True, draggable=True, showCloseIcon=True, viewPortBound=True)
		system.perspective.sendMessage("paramsChanged", params)
	
	return
